Name: Valko - New NPC
Author: LunaxLite
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8][size=5]Valko is waiting for you in the forest, will you bring him home?[/size][/color]


[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]DISCLAIMERS[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- This mod was designed around vanilla SDV. Heart events may look a little odd with modded maps. [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]- This mod was developed following the cancelation of Valko from Love and Deepspace. It pulls as much as it can from the trailers to establish him as a character in SDV, but of course this can't actually be the fully fledged Valko from LaDS. [/color]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Valko- The good boy himself as a fully fleshed out NPC and marriage candidate. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Dialogue Variety- Depending on how much of a hurry you're in, you can find many, many lines of dialogue waiting for you. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Villager Dialogues- The residents of Pelican Town have taken notice of the other new resident, and will share their own thoughts about him with you as time goes on.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Seasonal Outfits - Valko’s got three different outfits to make it through the year, and occasionally you'll find him in his lab coat.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Custom Spouse Room and Patio - Valko has his own tastes, and you'll get a peak into this here![/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Festival Participation - Valko will be present at every festival! Even he needs to take a vacation sometimes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]New Items - A handful of new items have been added to help pay tribute to what we do know about Valko, along with some other things for fun. Including…[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Two new cooking recipes - for hitting 3 and 7 hearts with Valko! Although, you might need to shop around for one of the ingredients.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]One new forage item- Keep your eyes peeled for a new plant. If you find it, I wouldn't recommend eating it…[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Forest Tent - When you first arrive, look for Valko’s tent in the forest![/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Heart Events - At this time, there are heart events at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14 hearts. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]More special surprises - You'll know them when you see them.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]Valko’s got his own story to tell, will you listen? Just be mindful of what you say to him.[/size] [/color]

[b]Trigger Conditions[/b][/color]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8]Two Hearts - Enter town at anytime[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Four Hearts - Enter the mountains at night Spoiler- The answer you give Valko here will affect something else later on…[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Six Hearts - Enter Valko’s tent while he's in it[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Eight Hearts - Enter the museum[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Ten Hearts - Check the mail for something special, then to to the bus stop between 2:00-6:00 on a sunny day

Twelve Hearts - Enter the forest at night[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Fourteen Hearts - Enter the farmhouse at night, have the house upgraded to level 2 (have the kid room)[/color][/spoiler]



[color=#D4D4D8]Additional 10 Heart Info[/color]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8]It's judgement time! Valko's grandmother has some questions to ask you. How you answer will impact how Valko's family views you. Remember the four heart event? That also factors in here. But n[/color][color=#d4d4d8]o matter what you choose in the four heart event, you can still get the best ending here.
 [/color]
Answer Key:
Q0 (4 Heart Check)
[quote]Valko. How did the farmer react when they learned you were a werewolf?[/quote]If you chose "Not at all, that’s awesome!" > +2 points
If you chose "I’m... not sure how I feel about it." > +1 point
If you chose "Yeah. It does." > +0 points

Q1
[quote]I see. And what do you think of Valko being a werewolf at this point?[/quote]"I mean... it's fine." > +1 points
"I don't like it." > +0 point
"I think it's an awesome part of him." > +2 points

Q2
[quote]I'm curious, farmer, do you regret taking over your grandfather's farm?[/quote]"Yes, everyday. My life in the city was much easier." > +0 points
"It's hard work, so sometimes I do." > +1 point
"Not at all. This is much more fulfilling." > +2 points

Q3
[quote]What is your favorite part of working the farm?[/quote]"I’ve been able to make an impact on the town and its people, for the better." > +2 points
"Yes, everyday. My life in the city was much easier." > +0 point
"It's hard work, so sometimes I do." > +1 points

Q4
[quote]I'm sure Valko has spoken to you about his... business goals. What's your opinion on caring for the environment?[/quote]"I mean it’s something to consider, but sometimes it can’t be helped." > +1 points
"It's important, and everyone's responsibility." > +2 point
"It's not my problem." > +0 points

Q5
[quote]Do you think werewolves and humans should intermingle?[/quote]"Yes, I think everyone should have the chance to do as they please." > +2 points
"If they want to I guess, but werewolves should probably be careful." > +1 point
"That’s just asking for trouble I’d say." > +0 points[/spoiler]
